titleEn: The Tibetan Book of the Dead — The third day ends, the fourth, and the fifth begins: Ratnasambhava's prayer, Amitābha, Amoghasiddhi
part: 5 · The third day ends, the fourth, and the fifth begins: Ratnasambhava's prayer, Amitābha, Amoghasiddhi
draftNote: Read from one blockprint at the resolution of an online scan; doubtful places are marked in the notes, and the text has not yet been collated with other prints.
source: Zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol las: Chos nyid bar do'i gsal 'debs thos grol chen mo, pages 45–54 of the reproduction, from an undated Tibetan blockprint of the Thos grol cycle reproduced by the Buddhist Digital Resource Center as W23710 (text kha), read from the page images. It is a traditional blockprint, so no modern editor's work is involved. Two transcriptions found online, one of this print and one of another, were used to check the reading and are not the text. The page gives the print's wording and spelling. Three things are ours: the spaces between words, which Tibetan does not write; the line-end abbreviations, written out; and clear misprints corrected, each named in its note. Where another print reads differently in a way that matters, the note says so. Letters: the Wylie system (Extended Wylie for the Sanskrit words). Pronunciation: the reading style of central Tibet in the THL Simplified Phonetic Transcription (Germano and Tournadre, 2003), produced by rule from the spelling; a living reader's pronunciation will differ in places. The translation is new, made from the Tibetan. Still to do: the text has been read from one print at the resolution of an online scan, and doubtful places are marked in the notes; it has not been collated with the other blockprints.

sentences.n: The sentence of the second day, with two differences: here the print has de ni, 'that is', for de nas, 'then', and the terror of the bardo ('jigs skrag) for its narrow passage, the two readings the other recension had there. sentences.i: If you are attached to it, you will fall into the abode of humans and go through the suffering of birth, old age, sickness and death, and the time of getting out of the mire of saṃsāra will not come.
sentences.n: mi'i gnas, 'the abode of humans', where this day's dull light leads. ltung, 'to fall', is the present and future stem of the verb whose past is lhung, which the print writes on the second day and below; the sense is the same. skye rga na 'chi, 'birth, ageing, sickness and death', the four great sufferings of a human life: na here is 'to be ill' (na ba), not the particle 'if'. nyams su myong, 'to experience, to go through', one word as nyams su blangs, 'to put into practice', in the pilot. 'dam, 'mud, mire', as on the second day; thon, 'to get out, to emerge'. The other recension has 'the time of being freed from the place of saṃsāra' ('khor ba'i gnas nas thar ba'i dus).

sentences.l:
Alas! Pride fierce-by in-saṃsāra wandering's time,
the sameness wisdom bright's light-path on,
the Blessed-One Ratnasambhava the-way lead!
The mother supreme Māmakī of(by?) from-behind support!
The between fearful's narrow-passage from freeing I-pray;
the genuine perfect buddha's level-to bring!
sentences.i:
Alas! When I wander in saṃsāra through fierce pride,
on the bright light-path of the wisdom of sameness
may the Blessed One Ratnasambhava lead the way,
may the supreme mother Māmakī support me from behind.
I pray you, free me from the fearful narrow passage of the bardo
and bring me to the level of a true and perfect buddha.
sentences.n: The prayer of the first two days, with the third day's poison, wisdom, buddha and consort. mnyam nyid ye shes is mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes, 'the wisdom of sameness', shortened for the metre. mA ma ki yi has yi, 'of', where the line wants yis, 'by', as the first day's consort has it and the other recension has here: 'from behind Māmakī' gives little sense, and it is read as 'by', as the print elsewhere writes gi for gis (gcig gi in the pilot). bskyor, past and future stem of skyor, 'hold up', as on the second day; skyol, 'bring!', as on the first.

sentences.i: When he is pointed out in this way, there is no doubt that he will be freed, however weak his faculties.
sentences.n: dbang po, 'faculty', a person's capacity for the teaching. The print has gzhan yang, 'others too' (gzhan, 'other'; yang, 'also'), which gives no clear sense after ji ltar, 'however'; the other recension has ji ltar zhan kyang, 'however weak (zhan) they are', and the sentence is translated by that sense. The letters of the print are clear, and how its reading came about cannot be told, so it is kept; the translation of these words is uncertain. The print writes med do contracted (མེདོ); it is written out here, as the print's other contractions are.

sentences.l:
Alas! Desire fierce-by in-saṃsāra wandering's time,
the discerning wisdom bright's light-path on,
the Blessed-One Amitābha the-way lead!
The mother supreme White-Robed-One by from-behind support!
The between fearful's narrow-passage from freeing I-pray;
the genuine perfect buddha's level-to bring!
sentences.i:
Alas! When I wander in saṃsāra through fierce desire,
on the bright light-path of the discerning wisdom
may the Blessed One Amitābha lead the way,
may the supreme mother, the White-Robed One, support me from behind.
I pray you, free me from the fearful narrow passage of the bardo
and bring me to the level of a true and perfect buddha.
sentences.n: The prayer again, with the fourth day's poison, wisdom, buddha and consort. sor rtogs ye shes is so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes, shortened for the metre. The consort has yis, 'by', as on the first day. bskyol is none of the regular stems of skyel, 'to bring' (skyel / bskyal / bskyal / skyol); it is read as the imperative skyol, 'bring!', written with a prefixed b-, the print's spelling (the other recension has skyol). bskyor, 'hold up', the past and future stem of skyor, as on the third day.

glossary.ཐོབ་ཅིག: thob cig — uncertain; perhaps 'obtain!' (thob 'obtain, get' + cig, which marks a command); gsol ba thob cig gives no clear sense, and is read, as a guess, 'make the prayer'
glossary.དག་པའི: dag pa'i — of the pure (dag pa 'pure' + -'i 'of')
glossary.དགའ་བར: dga' bar — with delight, gladly (dga' 'glad, delight' + -bar, making an adverb): dga' bar byed 'take delight'
glossary.དང: dang — and; with · after a verb: 'as soon as' (brgyal bsangs pa dang 'as soon as the faint has cleared')
glossary.དངངས་སྐྲག: dngangs skrag — dread and terror (dngangs, the print's spelling of sngangs 'dread', + skrag 'be frightened')
glossary.དབང་པོ: dbang po — faculty, capacity; a person's natural ability
glossary.དབྱེར་མེད་དུ: dbyer med du — inseparably, without being apart (dbyer med 'without separation' + -du)
glossary.དམ་ཚིག: dam tshig — vow, sacred bond (Sanskrit samaya)
glossary.དམ་ཚིག་སྒྲོལ་མ: dam tshig sgrol ma — Samayatārā, 'Tārā of the Commitment' (dam tshig 'sacred commitment' + sgrol ma 'she who frees'): the consort of the north
glossary.དུས་སུ: dus su — at the time (dus + su 'at')
glossary.དེ: de — that; he, it. After a verb (also te, ste): 'and then'
glossary.དེ་ཙ་ན: de tsa na — at that time, then (de 'that' + tsa na; a set phrase)
glossary.དེ་ལྟར: de ltar — thus, in that way (de 'that' + ltar 'like')
glossary.དེ་ལྟར་དུ: de ltar du — in that way, thus (de ltar 'thus' + -du)
glossary.དེ་སྐད: de skad — thus, in those words (de 'that' + skad 'speech, words')
glossary.དོན་ཡོད་གྲུབ་པ: don yod grub pa — Amoghasiddhi, 'He Whose Aim Is Accomplished' (don yod 'not in vain' + grub pa 'accomplished'): the buddha of the north and of the fifth day
glossary.དོན་ཡོད་གྲུབ་པའི: don yod grub pa'i — of Amoghasiddhi (don yod 'not in vain' + grub pa 'accomplished' + -'i 'of')
glossary.དྲག་པོའི: drag po'i — of the fierce, of the strong (drag po 'fierce' + -'i 'of')
glossary.དྲག་པོས: drag pos — by the fierce, by the strong (drag po 'fierce' + -s 'by')
glossary.དྲུག་ཏུ: drug tu — among six, as six (drug 'six' + -tu 'among, as'): rigs drug tu 'among the six kinds'; sku drug tu 'as six bodies'
glossary.ན: na — if, when (after the verb); also 'in, at' · to be ill, sickness (na, the verb of na ba): skye rga na 'chi 'birth, ageing, sickness and death'
glossary.ནམ་མཁའ་ལྡིང: nam mkha' lding — the garuḍa, the great bird (nam mkha' 'sky' + lding 'soar, hover': 'soaring in the sky')
glossary.ནས: nas — from; after a verb: 'having done, and then'
glossary.ནི: ni — as for: marks the topic of the sentence
glossary.པདྨ: padma — lotus (Sanskrit padma, written with stacked letters; said 'pema'). Here the Lotus family, the deities grouped around Amitābha · the flower itself, as an emblem held in the hand: phyag na padma bsnams pa 'holding a lotus in the hand'
glossary.ཕུང་པོ: phung po — mass, heap (phung po) · aggregate, one of the five that make up a person (phung po; Sanskrit skandha)
glossary.ཕྱག: phyag — hand (phyag), the respectful word; also 'homage'
glossary.ཕྲག་དོག: phrag dog — jealousy, envy (phrag dog): the mind's poison of the fifth day
glossary.བཀག་པའི: bkag pa'i — of what has blocked, that blocks (bkag, past stem of 'gog 'to block', + -pa'i 'of'): a clause placed before its noun
glossary.བཀྲག་མདངས་ཅན: bkrag mdangs can — having lustre and radiance, lustrous and radiant (bkrag 'lustre' + mdangs 'glow' + can 'having')
glossary.བཀྲག་མེད་པ: bkrag med pa — lustreless, dull (bkrag 'lustre' + med pa 'without')
glossary.བཀྲེས་སྐོམ: bkres skom — hunger and thirst (bkres 'hungry' + skom 'thirsty')
glossary.བག་ཆགས: bag chags — habitual tendencies, the traces past actions leave in the mind (bag chags; Sanskrit vāsanā)
glossary.བཅས་ཏེ: bcas te — together with (bcas + te; dang bcas te: 'along with')
glossary.བཅོམ་ལྡན: bcom ldan — Blessed One, a title of a buddha (bcom ldan, short for bcom ldan 'das)
glossary.བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས: bcom ldan 'das — the Blessed One, a title of a buddha (bcom ldan 'das, Sanskrit bhagavān; 'das 'gone beyond')
glossary.བཏབ་པས: btab pas — by having given, because it is given (btab pa + -s 'by')
glossary.བདེ་བ་ཅན: bde ba can — the Blissful, Sukhāvatī, the buddha-field of the west (bde ba 'bliss' + can 'having')
glossary.བཞི་པ: bzhi pa — fourth (bzhi 'four' + -pa): zhag bzhi pa 'the fourth day'
glossary.བཞུགས་པ: bzhugs pa — abiding, being present (bzhugs, respectful 'stay' + -pa) · seated, sitting (bzhugs, also the respectful 'sit'): … la bzhugs pa 'seated on …'
glossary.བཟོད་པ: bzod pa — bearing, endurance (bzod 'bear, endure' + -pa): mi bzod pa 'unbearable'
glossary.བར་ཆད: bar chad — obstacle, hindrance, interruption (bar chad)
glossary.བར་དུ: bar du — until, up to (bar 'interval' + -du 'to'); after ma + verb + gyi: 'until it comes'
glossary.བར་དོ: bar do — the between: the interval between two states, above all between death and rebirth (bar 'between' + do 'two')
glossary.བར་དོའི: bar do'i — of the bardo (bar do + -'i 'of')
glossary.བརྒྱན་པ: brgyan pa — adorned, decorated (brgyan, past of rgyan 'to adorn', + -pa)
glossary.བལྟ་བར: blta bar — in looking, looking (blta, future stem of lta 'look', + -bar): mig ma blta bar 'without looking with the eye'
glossary.བསགས་པའི: bsags pa'i — of what is gathered, which has been gathered (bsags 'gather, pile up', past of gsog, + -pa'i 'of'): a clause placed before its noun
glossary.བསུ་བ: bsu ba — meeting, welcoming, going out to meet someone (bsu 'to meet, welcome' + -ba); bsu ba la 'ongs 'come to meet'
glossary.བསུ་བའི: bsu ba'i — of welcoming, of meeting (bsu ba 'welcoming' + -'i 'of')
glossary.བསྐོར: bskor — surrounded, encircled (bskor, past of skor 'to surround, to circle')
glossary.བསྐྱེད: bskyed — produced, generated; to produce (bskyed, past and future of skyed 'to produce', the causative of skye 'be born')
glossary.བསྐྱོད: bskyod — stirred, set in motion (bskyod, past and future stem of skyod 'to move, to stir')
glossary.བསྐྱོར: bskyor — held up, to hold up, support (bskyor, past and future stem of skyor 'hold up'); in a request, perhaps standing for 'hold up!'
glossary.བསྐྱོལ: bskyol — bring! (bskyol, read as skyol, the imperative of skyel 'bring', written with a prefixed b-)
glossary.བསྒྲལ་དུ: bsgral du — to free, to deliver (bsgral, future stem of sgrol 'to free', + -du): bsgral du gsol 'I pray that you free'
glossary.བོད: bod — will call, to call (bod, the future stem of 'bod 'to call')
glossary.བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའ: byang chub sems dpa' — bodhisattva (byang chub 'awakening' + sems dpa' 'hero of mind')
glossary.བྱར་མེད: byar med — with nothing to do, effortless (bya, future stem of byed 'do', 'to be done', + -r + med 'there is not')
glossary.བྱེད་ཅིག: byed cig — do (byed, the present stem of byed 'do', + cig, which marks a command): with ma, a prohibition, ma byed cig 'do not do!' (the imperative of byed is gyis)
glossary.བྱོན་ནོ: byon no — comes, came (byon, the respectful 'come, go', used of a buddha or other honoured being, with one form for every tense, + the sentence-ending -no)
glossary.བྲོས: bros — fled, ran away (bros, past of 'bros 'flee')
glossary.བྲོས་ཅིག: bros cig — flee! (bros, the imperative of 'bros 'to flee', + cig, which marks a command; the rule gives shig after s, the print writes cig); ma bros cig 'do not flee'
glossary.བྲོས་བས: bros bas — because (they) fled, fleeing (bros, past of 'bros 'to flee', + -bas, the print's spelling of -pas 'because'): runs on to what follows
glossary.བྲོས་སུ: bros su — fleeing, in flight (bros, past of 'bros 'to flee', + -su): bros su 'ong 'will flee'
glossary.མ: ma — not (before past and imperative verbs) · in a prohibition also before the present stem: ma byed cig 'do not do!'
glossary.མཆིའོ: mchi'o — I go (mchi, the humble 'go', + the sentence-ending -'o)
glossary.མཉམ་ཉིད: mnyam nyid — sameness, equality (mnyam 'equal' + nyid 'itself'): mnyam nyid ye shes 'the wisdom of sameness', shortened from mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes
glossary.མཉམ་དུ: mnyam du — together, along with (mnyam 'equal, same' + -du)
glossary.མཚེར་བ: mtsher ba — shimmering (the print's spelling, read as 'tsher ba; mtsher is no known word)
glossary.མར: mar — down, downward (mar, the opposite of yar 'up'); of time, 'on, onward' · butter (mar), another word of the same spelling
glossary.མཱ་མ་ཀི: mā ma ki — Māmakī, 'She Who Is Mine': a Sanskrit name in Tibetan letters, the consort of the south
glossary.མི: mi — not (before present and future verbs)
glossary.མིའི: mi'i — of humans, of a human (mi 'human' + -'i 'of')
glossary.མེད་དོ: med do — there is not (med + the sentence-ending -do)
glossary.མེད་པ: med pa — without, not existing (med + pa)
glossary.མོས་གུས: mos gus — devotion and respect (mos 'devotion' + gus 'respect')
glossary.མོས་པ: mos pa — devotion, trust, interest (mos pa)
glossary.མྱོང: myong — to experience, to suffer, to undergo (myong)
glossary.ཙམ་དུ: tsam du — just so far, just to the point of (tsam + du)
glossary.ཚེ་འདས: tshe 'das — one whose life has passed, the dead person (tshe 'life' + 'das 'gone beyond')
glossary.ཞག: zhag — day, a day and night (zhag)
glossary.ཞལ་སྦྱར: zhal sbyar — in union, face joined to face (zhal 'face', respectful, + sbyar 'joined')
glossary.ཞིང: zhing — and, while: links one verb to the next (zhing, the form used after a vowel and after ng, n, m, r, l, '; also cing, shing)
glossary.ཞིང་ཁམས་སུ: zhing khams su — in the realm, in the buddha-field (zhing khams 'realm' + -su 'in')
glossary.ཞེན་ཅིག: zhen cig — cling! (zhen 'cling' + cig, which marks a command); ma zhen cig 'do not cling'
glossary.ཞོག་ཅིག: zhog cig — leave it! rest! (zhog, imperative of 'jog 'to put, to leave', + cig, which marks a command)
glossary.ཟིན་པར: zin par — seizing, holding (zin + -par): zin par the tshom med 'no doubt that (they) will seize it' · caught, held (zin pa + -r): mi zin par 'without being caught'
glossary.ཟུག: zug — to pierce, to stab, to stick in (zug)
glossary.འཁོར་བའི: 'khor ba'i — of saṃsāra, of the round ('khor ba 'the round, saṃsāra' + -'i 'of')
glossary.འཁོར་བར: 'khor bar — in saṃsāra, in the round ('khor ba 'the round, saṃsāra' + -r 'in')
glossary.འཁྱམས་པའི: 'khyams pa'i — of wandering, when one wanders ('khyams 'wander' + -pa'i 'of')
glossary.འགྱུར་རོ: 'gyur ro — becomes, will become ('gyur 'to become, to change' + the sentence-ending -ro)
glossary.འཆར: 'char — to dawn, to arise, to appear
glossary.འཆར་དུ: 'char du — to dawn, to arise ('char 'dawn, arise' + -du 'to'): 'char du 'ong 'will dawn'
glossary.འཇམ་དཔལ: 'jam dpal — Mañjuśrī, 'Gentle Glory' ('jam 'gentle' + dpal 'glory'): the bodhisattva of wisdom
glossary.འཇའ་འོད་དུ: 'ja' 'od du — as rainbow light, into rainbow light ('ja' 'rainbow' + 'od 'light' + -du 'as, into')
glossary.འཇིགས: 'jigs — to fear, to be afraid ('jigs); fear
glossary.འཇིགས་པའི: 'jigs pa'i — of fear, fearful, terrifying ('jigs pa 'fear' + -'i 'of')
glossary.འཇིགས་པར: 'jigs par — in fear, afraid ('jigs pa 'fear' + -r): ma 'jigs par 'without fear, not fearing'
glossary.འཇིགས་ཤིག: 'jigs shig — be afraid! ('jigs 'fear' + shig, which marks a command); ma 'jigs shig 'do not be afraid'
glossary.འདི་སྐད་དུ: 'di skad du — in these words, thus ('di 'this' + skad 'speech, words' + -du 'in')
glossary.འདི་སྐད་དོ: 'di skad do — these words (are said) ('di 'this' + skad 'speech' + the sentence-ending -do)
glossary.འདུ་འབྲལ: 'du 'bral — meeting and parting ('du 'meet, gather' + 'bral 'part'); 'du 'bral med pa 'without meeting or parting'
glossary.འདུ་ཤེས: 'du shes — notion, perception, idea ('du shes; Sanskrit saṃjñā)
glossary.འདོད་ཆགས: 'dod chags — desire, passion ('dod 'want' + chags 'attachment'): the mind's poison of the fourth day
glossary.འཕྲང: 'phrang — narrow passage, defile, a dangerous place on a road ('phrang)
glossary.འཕྲོད་པའི: 'phrod pa'i — of the meeting, of recognition ('phrod 'meet' + -pa'i 'of'): ngo 'phrod pa'i gnad 'the key to recognition'
glossary.འབྱུང: 'byung — to come about, to occur, to arise ('byung; byung is its past)
glossary.འབྱུང་བ: 'byung ba — element, one of the five of which the world is made: earth, water, fire, wind, space ('byung ba, literally 'what arises') · arising, coming about ('byung 'arise' + -ba)
glossary.འོང: 'ong — comes, happens, it may happen that ('ong 'come')
glossary.འོང་བ: 'ong ba — coming (the present stem 'ong 'come' + -ba): 'ong ba yin no 'is coming'
glossary.འོང་བས: 'ong bas — because it comes, since it will come ('ong 'come' + -bas, the print's spelling of -pas 'because')
glossary.འོད་དཔག་མེད: 'od dpag med — Measureless Light: the usual Tibetan name of Amitābha ('od 'light' + dpag med 'beyond measure')
glossary.འོད་ཟེར: 'od zer — ray of light, radiance ('od 'light' + zer 'ray')
glossary.འོད་ལམ: 'od lam — light-path, path of light ('od 'light' + lam 'path')
glossary.ཡང: yang — also, even, though (written kyang after g, d, b, s) · again, once more, at the head of a sentence (yang ngo sprad pa ni 'and the pointing out again')
glossary.ཡང་དག: yang dag — true, genuine, perfect (yang dag): yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'true and perfect buddha' (Sanskrit samyaksaṃbuddha)
glossary.ཡབ་ཡུམ: yab yum — father and mother; a buddha and his consort in union (yab 'father' + yum 'mother')
glossary.ཡི: yi — of (the form used after a vowel, yi; also gi, kyi, gyi, -'i) · perhaps 'by', standing for yis, where the verse needs it
glossary.ཡི་དྭགས: yi dwags — hungry ghost (yi dwags; Sanskrit preta), a being tormented by hunger and thirst
glossary.ཡིན་ནོ: yin no — is, are (yin 'to be' + the sentence-ending -no)
glossary.ཡིན་བའི: yin ba'i — which is, of being (yin 'be' + -ba'i, the print's spelling of -pa'i 'of')
glossary.ཡིས: yis — by (the 'by' ending after a vowel, used in verse; yis)
glossary.ཡུན་རིང་པའི: yun ring pa'i — of long duration, long-lasting (yun 'duration' + ring pa 'long' + -'i 'of')
glossary.ཡུམ: yum — mother; a buddha's female partner, consort (yum)
glossary.ཡེ་ཤེས: ye shes — wisdom, primordial knowing (ye 'from the first' + shes 'know'; Sanskrit jñāna)
glossary.ཡེ་ཤེས་སུ: ye shes su — as wisdom (ye shes 'wisdom' + -su 'as'): ye shes su ngo shes 'recognise as wisdom'
glossary.ཡེངས་པར: yengs par — distractedly, in distraction (yengs pa 'to be distracted' + -r): ma yengs par 'undistracted'
glossary.རང་མདངས་སུ: rang mdangs su — as one's own radiance (rang 'own' + mdangs 'glow' + -su 'as')
glossary.རབ་བརྩེགས་པའི: rab brtsegs pa'i — of Heaped Up, of the piled high (rab 'very' + brtsegs 'piled up', past of rtseg + -pa'i 'of'): the name of a buddha-field of the north
glossary.རིག་པའི: rig pa'i — of knowing, of awareness (rig pa 'knowing' + -'i 'of')
glossary.རིགས་ཀྱི་བུ: rigs kyi bu — child of the family, child of noble family (rigs 'family' + kyi 'of' + bu 'son, child'; Sanskrit kulaputra)
glossary.རིགས་པ: rigs pa — knowing, awareness: rig pa as printed once with a final s (rigs pa); the print elsewhere writes rig pa, and it is read so (rigs pa as a word is 'reasoning, what is fitting', which gives no sense here)
glossary.རིན་ཆེན་འབྱུང་ལྡན: rin chen 'byung ldan — Source of Jewels (rin chen 'jewel, precious thing' + 'byung ldan 'having arising'; Sanskrit Ratnasambhava): the buddha of the south and of the third day
glossary.རྒ: rga — old age, ageing; to grow old (rga)
glossary.རྒྱབ: rgyab — back, behind (rgyab): rgyab nas 'from behind'
glossary.རྟོགས་བའི: rtogs ba'i — of understanding, of discerning (rtogs 'understand' + -ba'i, the print's spelling of -pa'i 'of')
glossary.རྡོ་རྗེ་རྒྱ་གྲམ: rdo rje rgya gram — crossed vajra (Sanskrit viśvavajra; rdo rje 'vajra' + rgya gram 'cross'): two vajras laid across each other, the emblem of the north
glossary.རྣམ་པར: rnam par — completely, in every way (rnam par): rnam par dag pa 'completely pure'
glossary.རྨ་བྱའི: rma bya'i — of a peacock (rma bya 'peacock' + -'i 'of')
glossary.རྩེ་གཅིག: rtse gcig — one-pointed, single-minded (rtse 'point, tip' + gcig 'one')
glossary.རྩེ་གཅིག་ཏུ: rtse gcig tu — one-pointedly, with a single mind (rtse 'point, tip' + gcig 'one' + -tu)
glossary.རྫོགས་པའི: rdzogs pa'i — of the perfect, complete (rdzogs pa 'perfect' + -'i 'of')
glossary.རླུང: rlung — wind; the breath-energy that moves in the body's channels (Sanskrit prāṇa)
glossary.ལ: la — to, at, in, for; after a verb or adjective: 'and' · among (… kyi rigs la 'among those of the … kind') · on (… la bzhugs 'seated on …')
glossary.ལ་སོགས་པ: la sogs pa — and the like, and so on (la 'to' + sogs 'et cetera' + -pa)
glossary.ལ་སོགས་པའི: la sogs pa'i — of those and the like, and so on (la sogs pa + -'i 'of')
glossary.ལན་མང་དུ: lan mang du — many times, often (lan 'time, occasion' + mang 'many' + -du)
glossary.ལམ་སྣ: lam sna — head of the road, the way ahead (lam 'path' + sna 'front, head'): lam sna drongs 'lead the way'
glossary.ལས: las — from, out of · karma, action (las): las kyi 'of karma'; after a verb or noun, 'other than, of, from among'
glossary.ལས་ངན: las ngan — bad karma (las 'action, karma' + ngan 'bad')
glossary.ལོངས་སྤྱོད་རྫོགས་པའི་སྐུ་རུ: longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ru — as the body of perfect enjoyment (longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'body of perfect enjoyment', the radiant form in which a buddha appears in visions, + -ru 'as')
glossary.ལོངས་སྤྱོད་རྫོགས་པའི་སྐུར: longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur — as the body of perfect enjoyment (longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku + -r 'as')
glossary.ལྔ་པ: lnga pa — fifth (lnga 'five' + -pa): zhag lnga pa 'the fifth day'
glossary.ལྕགས་ཀྱུ: lcags kyu — iron hook (lcags 'iron' + kyu 'hook'): the hook by which the light of compassion draws one out
glossary.ལྕགས་ཀྱུས: lcags kyus — by the hook (lcags kyu 'iron hook' + -s 'by')
glossary.ལྟུང: ltung — to fall (ltung, the present and future stem of the verb whose past is lhung)
glossary.ལྡན་པའི: ldan pa'i — of the endowed, endowed with (ldan pa 'having' + -'i 'of'): dpal dang ldan pa'i 'endowed with glory'
glossary.ལྷ་མ་ཡིན: lha ma yin — demigod, asura (lha ma yin 'not-god'): a being who wars with the gods out of envy
glossary.ལྷ་ཚོགས: lha tshogs — host of deities (lha 'god' + tshogs 'host, gathering')
glossary.ཤང་ཤང: shang shang — shang-shang, a winged creature of the garuḍa kind, in pictures part bird and part human
glossary.ཤིང: shing — and, while (links two verbs; also cing, zhing)
glossary.ཤེས: shes — to know, to recognise (shes); ngo shes 'recognise, know the face'
glossary.ས་རུ: sa ru — to the level, to the stage (sa 'ground, level' + -ru 'to'): the stage a buddha has reached
glossary.སངས་རྒྱས་པར: sangs rgyas par — to being a buddha, as a buddha (sangs rgyas 'buddha' + -pa + -r 'to'): sangs rgyas par 'gyur 'become a buddha'
glossary.སེམས་ཅན: sems can — sentient being, living creature (sems can)
glossary.སེམས་མ: sems ma — female bodhisattva (sems ma, short for sems dpa' ma)
glossary.སོ་སོར: so sor — one by one, each by itself (so so 'each' + -r): so sor rtogs pa 'discerning each thing by itself'
glossary.སོར་རྟོགས: sor rtogs — the discerning (wisdom) (sor rtogs, shortened from so sor rtogs pa 'discerning each thing by itself')
glossary.སྐལ་ཆད: skal chad — cut off from fortune, luckless (skal 'fortune, lot' + chad 'cut off', past of 'chad)
glossary.སྐུ་མདོག: sku mdog — body colour, colour of a buddha or deity (sku 'body' + mdog 'colour'), the respectful word
glossary.སྐྱབས་སུ: skyabs su — for refuge, as refuge (skyabs 'refuge' + -su 'to'): skyabs su mchi'o 'I go for refuge'
glossary.སྐྱེ: skye — birth, to be born (skye, the present and future stem; past skyes); skye rga na 'chi 'birth, ageing, sickness and death'
glossary.སྐྱེས: skyes — arisen, born (skyes, past of skye 'be born, arise')
glossary.སྐྱོལ: skyol — bring! deliver! (skyol, imperative of skyel 'to bring, to convey')
glossary.སྐྲག་པ: skrag pa — fright, being frightened (skrag 'be frightened' + -pa)
glossary.སྙིང: snying — heart (snying); snying mi dga' 'the heart not glad', sad
glossary.སྟབས: stabs — occasion, manner, circumstance (stabs): stabs kyis 'because of, by reason of'
glossary.སྟེ: ste — and, namely: a linking word after a verb or a statement, leading on to what follows (also te, de)
glossary.སྡིག་པོ་ཆེ: sdig po che — a great wrongdoer (sdig po 'wrongdoer' + che 'great')
glossary.སྡིག་སྒྲིབ: sdig sgrib — sinful obscuration, the veil that harmful deeds leave on the mind (sdig 'sin' + sgrib 'obscuration')
glossary.སྣང་བ་མཐའ་ཡས: snang ba mtha' yas — Boundless Appearance, Boundless Light: the buddha Amitābha (snang ba 'appearance, light' + mtha' yas 'without limit')
glossary.སྤོང་བར: spong bar — giving up (spong 'give up' + -bar): mi spong bar 'without giving up'
glossary.སྤོངས་ཤིག: spongs shig — give up! (spongs, imperative of spong 'give up', + shig, which marks a command)
glossary.སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས: spyan ras gzigs — Avalokiteśvara, 'the one who looks with the eyes' (spyan 'eye', respectful, + ras + gzigs 'look', respectful): the bodhisattva of compassion
glossary.སྨོན་ལམ: smon lam — prayer of aspiration (smon 'to wish' + lam 'path')
glossary.སྲིད་དོ: srid do — can be, is possible (srid 'be possible' + the sentence-ending -do): mi srid 'it cannot be, it is impossible'
glossary.ཨཱ་ལོ་ཀེ: ā lo ke — Ālokā, 'she of light' (ā lo ke, Sanskrit āloke, the form of address of the name Ālokā, from āloka 'light'): a female bodhisattva, a Sanskrit name in Tibetan letters

about: This part finishes the third day and tells the fourth, and the fifth begins. If the dead man does not recognise Ratnasambhava's yellow light as the radiance of his own awareness, he is to take refuge in it, turn away from the dull blue light of humans and its sufferings of birth, age, sickness and death, and say the prayer to Ratnasambhava; then he becomes a buddha in the southern realm. Some, great wrongdoers and those whose commitments are broken, still do not recognise it and flee, and on the fourth day the element fire dawns as a red light: from the western realm of Bliss Amitābha appears on a peacock throne, in union with the White-Robed One and surrounded by two bodhisattvas and two female bodhisattvas, and his red discerning wisdom comes together with the dull yellow light of the hungry ghosts. He is to rest in awareness or, failing that, take refuge, give up attachment and pray to Amitābha, and so become a buddha in the west. Those who have long kept company with their habitual tendencies are driven by jealousy and bad karma to wander on, and on the fifth day the element wind dawns as a green light: the part ends as Amoghasiddhi appears from the northern realm on a throne of shang-shang birds, in union with Samayatārā, while the light of the demigods comes too.
